text:
sara: Quick sync: prepping release notes for the docs push tomorrow. Features: adaptive batching (opt-in flag) and server-side request logs (preview). Need: one-line homepage blurb, 3 short bullets, and a 1-sentence known issue about localized screenshots + l10n anchors.
devin: I can write the bullets. Keep them customer-facing: no deep config. I'll include link to SDK guide for advanced config.
priya: I'll update SDK snippets — JS and Python examples changed shape. Note: JS now uses `client.options.batch = { mode: 'adaptive' }`. I'll open PRs.
sara: Please don't embed long config blocks in the relnotes. Tiny inline example is fine.
tim: Linkcheck on staging found two missing anchors under /fr/guides/config and one outdated redirect. l10n-bot flagged it. We should add a known issue line so customers don't get noise.
l10n-bot: automated: Missing anchors detected: /fr/guides/config#batching and /es/guides/overview#logs. See issue #1310.
priya: Snippet PRs: #1301 (py), #1302 (js) — updated usage and added note pointing to SDK reference. Small inline sample for relnotes: `client.configure({ batch: { mode: 'adaptive' } })`.
devin: Draft bullets: - Adaptive batching (experimental): reduces cost for bursty, low-concurrency workloads; opt in via SDK or Console. - Server-side request logs (preview): view request traces in Console with role-based access. - Migration tip: small SDK changes in batch config; see SDK reference. Known issue: localized screenshots in a few languages may show old UI labels; translations and cropped images are being updated.
sara: Nice. For the known issue let's make it tighter: "Localized screenshots may temporarily show outdated UI text; translations and images will be refreshed in the next patch." One line.
tim: After PRs land, I'll re-run linkcheck and add redirects for anchor mismatches if needed. If l10n-bot still flags, we will add a short follow-up note on the release page.
docs-bot: deploy-bot: branch docs/relnotes-3123456789 deployed to staging; site build passed with localization warnings.
priya: FYI I updated content/releases/next.md and added a tiny migration snippet under content/guides/cache-migration.md.
sara: Great. Plan: priyaj's snippets + devin's bullets merged, tim confirms linkcheck fixes, then I merge release. Target 08:30 PT tomorrow.
devin: Homepage blurb option: "Try adaptive batching (experimental) for cost-stable handling of bursty traffic; see release notes." Approve?
sara: Approve. I'll merge once CI is green. If anything breaks post-release, open an incidents thread and tag me.
